stem: A child is scheduled for hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT). Which dental plan best matches current guidance?

options.text: Finish needed dental treatment before immunosuppression begins and defer elective care until the immune system has recovered
Postpone all dental care, including treatment of infection, until after the transplant
Schedule elective dental procedures during the period of immunosuppression
Wait to perform the first oral examination until oral complications appear
